description: This file defines extension methods for configuring default Azure Storage options within the Orleans framework, including setting up Azure Blob Storage, Queue Storage, Table Storage clients using different authentication methods.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure Azure storage options for different parts of the Orleans framework.

methods.name: GetTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a TableServiceClient using authentication details from TestDefaultConfiguration.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.GrainDirectory.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures GrainDirectory Azure Storage options with a TableServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures Persistence Azure Storage options with a TableServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.Reminders.AzureStorage.AzureStorageOperationOptions)
methods.description: Configures Reminders Azure Storage options with a TableServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobStorageOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Storage options with a BlobServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.Configuration.AzureQueueOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Queue options with a QueueServiceClient.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults (overload for Orleans.Configuration.AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions)
methods.description: Configures Azure Blob Lease Provider options with a BlobServiceClient.
